title: Portable evaluator build probe preparation
problem: The pinned SDK lacks portable valid build-probe preparation and the served-catalog authority prerequisite required by the merged upstream fix.
localBehavior: Patch only reviewed SDK14.0.0-rc.53 CJS/ESM loader, runner, schema-authority and declaration preimages. A local creative_build_probe ALS scope is established before preflight and pairs served catalog selection with actual JSON capability validation (builtin or external); stock14 behavior remains outside that opt-in and for other tasks. Unlike the initial candidate, authority modules include an explicit maintenance delta and do not claim whole-module identity to15.9.5. Preserve request pins, accounting, general TaskExecutor and all four main helper payloads. Authority regressions use ledgered private scope/validator interfaces and owned temporary stock copies reconstructed by exact reverse hashes; no direct installed-package edits.
removalCondition: Remove after the upstream creative-build-probe runner fix is merged, available in a qualified SDK release, and both full and standalone regression suites pass after upgrading the pinned dependency. Do not release the SDK from this task.
